findings.title: Out-of-scope WIP file breaks `npm run typecheck`
findings.problem: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exits 1 with TS2307 for missing modules '@imgly/background-removal-node' and './ras-poster-story.js'. Verified the file is UNTRACKED (git status '??'), not referenced by any source file (grep shows only report mentions), and is the user's actively-edited scratch WIP (open in editor). It is not part of this task's diff and every FEAT file is type-clean on its own.
findings.fix: No action required for this task. The user owns this scratch file; it is unrelated to X discovery/ranking. If a fully-green typecheck is desired, exclude the templates scratch file from tsc or add the missing deps — but that is outside this task's scope.

summary: All five FEATs plus the integration wiring implement the approved design and all 8 final fixes correctly, verified by reading the code (not just the findings). FIX #1: dom_index is stamped by a monotonic counter in scrape_user's shared _scroll_and_harvest only in the first-sighting `if url not in collected` branch, NOT in HARVEST_JS. FIX #2: score.ts computes verified from item.isOfficialAccount read directly; runDiscovery computes isOfficialAccount once via learning.isOfficialAccount and stamps it + accountCredibilityScore + accountStatus at save time. FIX #3: accountStatus is defaulted ('candidate') on every saved item and at the rawToRankItem mapper; ONE shared groupTextKey (lowercase+NFKC+strip+first-12-tokens) is used by both buildCorroborationContext and corroborationGroupKey. FIX #4: one canonical urlKey() lowercases the host and is used on both corroboration sides (rssUrlSet built via urlKey, matched via urlKey/hostOf); corroboration.test.ts asserts the mixed-case host case and all 141 tests pass. FIX #5: the ~85 uncorroborated-RSS cap is documented in score.ts and the score.test comment and is NOT reweighted. FIX #6: postToRaw is exported with a back-compat opts? third param. FIX #7: select.ts breaks finalScore ties on r.item.engagementRaw?.views ?? 0 and ranking.config viewsBonusMax defaults 0. FIX #8: X facts[] are pinned to [{claim: derivedHeadline, sourceUrl, sourceType}] plus one entry per resolved outbound URL (deduped), with the vague claim-sentence extraction dropped. Hard constraints all hold: INSTAGRAM_DRY_RUN and REQUIRE_APPROVAL default true in both cron and workflow; no git push/commit/config anywhere in src; collectXPosts reads saved posts only (no scraper in its import graph) and fails soft to {items:[],perAccount:[]} so RSS keeps working when X is unavailable; the collectXPosts call in autoNewsToRas is additionally try/catch-wrapped; weights sum to EXACTLY 10.0 (2.0+2.5+1.5+1.0+0.0+0.75+0.75+1.0+0.5); every X/ranking number lives in config with env overrides and conservative defaults; `limited` stays exactly !!(paywalled||factPackLimited||viaFallback) with no `|| raw.signalOnly`. Authoritative verification: `npm run test` 141/141 pass; `npm run typecheck` is clean for all task code — the sole tsc error is in an untracked, unreferenced WIP scratch file (RasStoryTemplate-2.tsx) the user is editing, which is out of scope. No HIGH or MEDIUM findings.
